title: Items
description: data/items.json, and the workspace's items collection: every item keyed by its id. Loaded by src/config/registries/itemRegistry.js; authored in cms/src/components/editors/ItemEditor.jsx. Keys not listed here are reported as warnings (unknown keys), not errors.

id.description: The item's id, the same as its key (itemRegistry.js reads the key when id is missing). item_ followed by the slugged name while autoSyncId holds.

type.description: ITEM_TYPES (src/config/registries/itemRegistry.js). Display only (tint, Bank sort); derived by ItemEditor.jsx from the slot.

tags.description: Free words for display and Bank search only. No editor writes them (only the AI generator).

sprite.description: A sprite id or an assets/ path (src/utils/AssetManager.js resolveSpritePath).

stackable.description: false holds one per Bank slot (src/systems/inventory/InventoryManager.js); anything else stacks. No editor control.

restoreAmount.description: HP a food heals (src/systems/hero/ConsumptionSystem.js). Only food heals; drinks and consumables ignore it.

equipSlot.description: EQUIPMENT_CATEGORY_DEFS ids (src/config/registries/equipmentCategories.js); empty means it cannot be equipped. Read by EquipmentValidator.js and EquipmentManager.js.

value.description: Gold value, derived by Recalculate (cms/src/engine/sim/writeBack.js), never typed. Null means not yet derived. Read by the ledger only.

valueSource.description: The Token or recipe id the value was derived from (the simulator's anchor election); sticky until re-elected (cms/src/components/shared/AnchorElections.jsx).

autoSyncId.description: CMS only: true makes the id follow the name.

effects.description: Rules the item carries, as references into data/effects.json (src/systems/hero/HeroEffects.js itemStatements).

tool.description: What tool it is (src/config/registries/toolKinds.js toolOf, used by HeroTools.js).

kind.description: TOOL_KINDS (toolKinds.js); any other kind makes it not a tool.

tier.description: A whole number from 1; anything else reads as 1.

starter.description: true puts it in a new hero's hands (StarterTools.js).

styles.description: A weapon's combat skill (src/config/registries/weaponStyles.js); only the first counts, none means melee.

damage.description: A weapon's damage, a whole number from 1 (src/systems/combat/CombatFormulas.js); missing or 0 means unarmed (1).

tier.description: The material tier (1 copper, 2 iron, ...). Read only by the Bank's sort order.

damageType.description: DAMAGE_TYPES (src/config/registries/damageTypes.js weaponDamageTypeOf); missing means the style's default.

speed.description: ATTACK_SPEED_MS (src/config/FormulaRegistry.js): 2, 3 or 4 seconds a swing. Absent means normal.

hands.description: 2 makes it two-handed (toolKinds.js handsOf); anything else is one hand.

offHand.description: true makes a hand item an off-hand (weaponStyles.js, toolKinds.js).

resistances.description: Worn gear's resistances by damage type or group (physical, elemental, special): whole percent, not a fraction, -99 to 99 and not 0 (src/config/registries/gearDefence.js).

damageCut.description: Worn gear's cut of damage by combat style (melee, ranged, magic, stealth): whole percent 1 to 100 (gearDefence.js).

arrow.description: A consumable that is an arrow (src/config/registries/damageTypes.js arrowOf, src/systems/combat/Arrows.js).

isRoot.description: Read only by the CMS's connectivity audit (cms/src/engine/connectivityAuditor.js): a raw item nothing needs to produce. No game reader, no editor.
